channel.title: StackFit // Breakout Open Source Pulse
channel.description: Find the open-source tool you actually need — by what it replaces, what it runs on, and whether it's alive.

item.title: [Core] xerj-org/xerj (+2160 24h)
item.description:
Verdict:

Local-first search engine and MCP server for AI agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hybrid search, code search without grep, agent memory and RAG. Elasticsearch-compatible API; Corpus Hub serves hundreds of reference memory corpora.

  • Replaces: Incumbents
  • Stars: ⭐ 12,922 (+2160 in 24h)
  • Signal: CLIMBER
  • Hardware Viability: Minimal CPU
  • Quick Run: cargo install xerj
